name: traits_v1_haiku
guideline: You read one short news item (a headline and a one or two sentence description) and answer 51 questions about it.
Reply with the JSON object only. Each key is a question id; each value is exactly one of: 'not at all', 'slightly', 'clearly', 'strongly', 'cannot tell'.
Use only what the item says. Do not use background knowledge about the world or about the people and places named.
'not at all' means the item gives no sign of it. 'slightly' means a weak or passing sign. 'clearly' means the item plainly shows it. 'strongly' means it is the main point of the item.

Use 'cannot tell' only when the item gives no basis to judge the question either way, for example a question about timing for an item that gives no time. Do not use it for a plain no: that is 'not at all'.
Answer all 51 questions for every item.
